ezekiel.30.p1.b1.text: For the day is near, the Day of the LORD is near. It will be a day of clouds, a time of doom for the nations.

ezekiel.30.p1.b2.text: I will make the streams dry up

ezekiel.30.p1.b3.text: I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Memphis.

ezekiel.30.p1.b4.text: The day will be darkened in Tahpanhes … A cloud will cover her

ezekiel.30.p1.b5.text: Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

ezekiel.30.p1.b6.text: I will strengthen the arms of Babylon’s king and place My sword in his hand
